title: Schedules stay in the conversation
summary: Create and approve schedules from the Chat where they began, then see every result there. Desktop and mobile also make active work easier to find and control.

highlights.title: Schedules, right from Chat
highlights.body: Ask for a schedule in a private Chat, approve it beside the message, and see its history and results return to that same conversation, even after a restart.

highlights.title: A calmer place to work
highlights.body: The top bar makes more room for your work. Agent status groups and project conversation lists take you to the exact Chat, while a redesigned What's New keeps release history close.

highlights.title: More control in every reply
highlights.body: Choose a permission mode, reuse your last agent and model, copy code, share finished replies, and attach Matrix Files without leaving Chat.

items.text: Desktop agent sessions stay connected while their kernel socket is still opening.
Managed browser failures point to the right recovery action.
Existing shared-site links remain available while newer link types take over.
Sign-in returns you to AI Insights.
AI requests start faster and no longer block each other during billing checks.
Push settings are easier to find, and notifications re-register when the app opens.
Downloads, Trash and Matrix file attachments work more reliably.
